subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------DEC.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 264 (CMBA-20). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the subject; DEC (decentralization) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From TH-CONT: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DYM: INFO-DE (information degrees), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From INFO-DE: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and POL-SIGN (political significance). From POL-SIGN: PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism).
